When I tried to switch to `renderToPipeableStream` from `renderToString`, I found that in case of failed SSR render (no `Suspense` wrapper), I got unexpected `onAllReady` callback call, after `onError`/`onShellError`

React version: 19.2.7

## Steps To Reproduce

1. Clone https://github.com/SuperOleg39/render-to-stream-bug-reproduction
2. Call `npm install`
3. Call `node server.js`
4. Open/curl localhost:3000, and look for server logs in terminal

Link to code example:

https://github.com/SuperOleg39/render-to-stream-bug-reproduction

Example source code is AI generated, but it much simpler than our SSR meta-framework implementation, no offence :)

## The current behavior

When SSR failed, `onError`/`onShellError` called, then `onAllReady`

## The expected behavior

When SSR failed, only `onError`/`onShellError` called
raw.title: Bug: onAllReady called after onShellError
